title: 海杰风险管理王飞：AI建设是否过热？关键预警信号解析
speaker: Felix Wang

segments.en: A lot of these deals are to facilitate their worth, right? Because they're not investment grade companies, they may not be able to get a track their financing. So they need help and it really is a great sort of bridge to that.
segments.zh: 很多交易是为了支持它们的估值，因为它们不是投资级公司，可能无法获得传统融资，所以需要帮助，这确实是一座桥梁。

segments.en: Yeah, which is also raised the issue of, you know, how this is making the circular nature of the investing and, you know, inflating some of the demand for AI.
segments.zh: 这也引发了关于投资循环性以及AI需求被放大的问题。

segments.en: But Felix, you raised an interesting point that could still be the idea of, you know, we're building more than we actually need. What is your sense of what the earliest warning indicators, I guess, will be to know that we are in that stage of the AI buildout.
segments.zh: 你提到我们可能建设过度，那么最早出现哪些预警信号，表明AI建设进入过热阶段？

segments.en: So by overbuilding, what I mean by that is you start seeing AI monetization really turn. Whether it's AI growth, whether it's GPU utilization, whether, you know, if it's through these rental rates that we see from GPUs and even CPUs, if they start to turn self, particularly for black wild chips, particularly for upcoming rubens, that's not a good sign for, you know, building out this whole AI ecosystem.
segments.zh: 所谓过度建设，是指AI变现开始转向，比如AI增长、GPU利用率，或者GPU和CPU的租赁价格开始下滑，尤其是Blackwell和即将推出的Rubin芯片，这对整个AI生态建设不是好兆头。

segments.en: I mentioned earlier, you know, overbuilding, what if token growth is not 10X, 100X, what people are thinking the next five years, we have a really good read throughout token database, tracking about 800 LM models globally from both US and China.
segments.zh: 我之前提到，如果token增长不是人们预期的未来五年10倍、100倍呢？我们通过token数据库追踪全球约800个大模型，包括中美两国。

segments.en: So we keep a close eye on token growth to make sure, you know, it's at a good level to sustain higher and higher CAPEX spending and investment spending for the AI guys.
segments.zh: 我们密切关注token增长，以确保其能支撑AI领域不断攀升的资本开支和投入。

segments.en: So a lot of data out there that we can track to kind of gauge whether, you know, we could be sort of overbuilding at the top of the AI site going on, but I'm not saying that currently.
segments.zh: 我们有很多数据可以判断AI建设是否过热，但目前我并没有这么说。

segments.en: Felix, I know you're tracking, and you also cover China tech, we have 10 cent earnings coming up later on this week. It's interesting, right? You're starting to see investors more comfortable going back into some of the large cap tech in China.
segments.zh: 你也在关注中国科技股，腾讯本周将公布财报。有趣的是，投资者开始更愿意回归中国大型科技股。

segments.en: There's some traction when it comes to AI, we just talked about work buddy, from 10 cent, it's become one of the most popular AI assistants for the workplace. And really, in some ways, outperforming some of the peer plays, I know we had you on a few months ago when it came to your short position in Japan. So I'm just wondering how are you looking at the space right now?
segments.zh: AI方面有一些进展，比如腾讯的“元宝”已成为最受欢迎的职场AI助手之一，甚至超越了同行。几个月前你提到做空日本，现在你如何看待这个领域？
